windows.comment_U1: Hotkey-invoked panel; hidden until summoned. Instant-show is constraint U1 (p99<200ms).

security.comment_S2: Local-only, zero remote origins. CSP forbids outbound connections by default; plugins get network only via the broker (S1/S2).

_note: STRUCTURAL SKELETON (m4 task 4). Pins the security/UX-relevant config intent (CSP=S2, hidden hotkey panel=U1). The Tauri binary, frontend (../dist), and global-shortcut wiring are generated in the UI task of a later m4 pass. Not yet a runnable Tauri app.
